body: GET /api/documents returns paginated metadata without bodies; GET /api/documents/:kind/:id fetches one document (400 for unknown kind, 404 if missing). Reader loads on selection, ignores stale responses, caches by updatedAt, shows loading/missing/error states. Search hits for goals/plans/decisions now open the reader (type was plural). Verified in Chromium; server tests added.
author: claude
